title: Integrated production SPA and static Pages preview boundary
statement: Production serves the compiled SPA from the API image for same-origin behavior; GitHub Pages, when configured, publishes only a static preview.
rationale: Authentication, upload, media, and management flows require the API, while a Pages artifact can safely demonstrate only the browser shell.

evidence.locator: - Integrated into the API image for same-origin production delivery.
The API image contains the built SPA. Images use a glibc-based official .NET runtime, run non-root, and pin native libvips packages and base-image digests.
